entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nikolaos of Otranto, also known as Nektarios of Casole, was a Greek abbot and author born in the late 12th century in the Byzantine Empire. He played a significant role in the spiritual and intellectual landscape of the region, drawing on his experiences as a monk and his studies of theology and philosophy. His works, including the treatise on the resurrection of the dead, influenced Christian theology and liturgy for centuries to come.
